mapper.select: /* taskInqyDao1010 : 업무일지 조회 */ SELECT T.TASK_ID , T.TASK_SNO , T.TASK_TITLE , T.TASK_CONT , TO_CHAR(T.TASK_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS TASK_DT , T.TASK_HH , T.TASK_MM , T.PROJ_ID , P.PROJ_TITLE , T.REG_IDX , E.EMP_NM , O.ORG_NM , R.RANK_NM FROM TASK T LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON E.EMP_IDX = T.REG_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN RANK R ON R.RANK_CD = E.RANK_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN PROJECT P ON P.PROJ_ID = T.PROJ_ID WHERE T.REG_IDX = #{empIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.TASK_DT >= NVL(TO_DATE(#{srchDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND T.TASK_DT < NVL(TO_DATE(#{srchDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TRUNC(SYSDATE)) + 1 ORDER BY T.TASK_SNO ASC

/* taskInqyDao2020 : 업무일지 상세 조회 */ SELECT T.TASK_ID , T.TASK_SNO , T.TASK_TITLE , T.TASK_CONT , TO_CHAR(T.TASK_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS TASK_DT , T.TASK_HH , T.TASK_MM , T.PROJ_ID , P.PROJ_TITLE , T.REG_IDX , E.EMP_NM , O.ORG_NM , R.RANK_NM FROM TASK T LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON E.EMP_IDX = T.REG_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN RANK R ON R.RANK_CD = E.RANK_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN PROJECT P ON P.PROJ_ID = T.PROJ_ID WHERE T.TASK_ID = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.TASK_SNO ASC

/* taskInqyDao3020 : 업무 캘린더 상세 조회 */ SELECT TC.TLDR_ID , TC.TLDR_TITLE , TC.TLDR_CONT , SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_SDT,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_SDT,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_SDT,7) AS TLDR_SDT , SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_EDT,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_EDT,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_EDT,7) AS TLDR_EDT FROM TASK_CALENDAR TC WHERE 1=1 AND TC.TLDR_ID = #{tldrId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

/* taskInqyDao3030 : 업무 캘린더 (메인) 조회 */ SELECT TC.TLDR_ID , TC.TLDR_TITLE , TC.TLDR_CONT , SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_SDT,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_SDT,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_SDT,7) AS TLDR_SDT , SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_EDT,0,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_EDT,5,2) || '-' || SUBSTR(TC.TLDR_EDT,7) AS TLDR_EDT FROM TASK_CALENDAR TC WHERE 1=1 AND TC.EMP_IDX = #{empIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TC.TLDR_SDT AND TC.TLDR_EDT ORDER BY TC.TLDR_ID ASC

/* taskProcDao1010 : 업무일지 등록 처리 */
SELECT #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM DUAL
SELECT 'TASK_' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TASK_ID, 'TASK_', ''))), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM TASK
INSERT INTO TASK ( TASK_ID , TASK_SNO , TASK_TITLE , TASK_CONT , TASK_HH , TASK_MM , TASK_DT , PROJ_ID , REG_IDX , REG_DT , USE_YN , DISP_ORDER , REMARK ) VALUES ( #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , (SELECT LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(TASK_SNO)), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM TASK WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) , #{taskTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{taskCont, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{taskHh, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , #{taskMm, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , TO_DATE(#{taskDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , #{projId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{regIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , SYSDATE , 'Y' , (SELECT NVL(MAX(DISP_ORDER), 0) + 1 FROM TASK WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) , NULL )

/* taskProcDao2010 : 업무 캘린더 등록 처리 */ INSERT INTO TASK_CALENDAR ( TLDR_ID , TLDR_TITLE , TLDR_CONT , TLDR_SDT , TLDR_EDT , EMP_IDX , REG_DT , REG_TM , USE_YN , DISP_ORDER , REMARK ) VALUES ( ( SELECT 'TLDR_' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(REPLACE(TLDR_ID,'TLDR_')),0) + 1,4,0) FROM TASK_CALENDAR ) , #{tldrTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{tldrCont, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , REPLACE(#{tldrSdt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-') , REPLACE(#{tldrEdt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-') , #{empIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HHMMSS') , 'Y' , ( SELECT NVL(MAX(DISP_ORDER),0) + 1 FROM TASK_CALENDAR ) , NULL )
